standfirst: EIAV is the lentivirus of horses and the smallest module in this family — one virus, little vocabulary, and the clearest example in the set of a tiny accessory gene that is nonetheless essential. Four features carry profiles; rev is declared and called by the splice caller, and tat is recognised but not declared.

modules.EIAV: S2 is 59–83 aa and is called on every exemplar. It was marked essential on evidence: 30 of 30 held-out genomes, and out of frame with env in 29 of 29 — a separate gene, not a cleavage product of the envelope it sits inside.

gaps: tat is spliced in EIAV and is not declared; the string is recognised and recorded, which is why the collapse report shows it bound to a target the module JSON does not carry. gag, pol and env are each called on 10 of 11 exemplars; the one miss is a single short record, not a profile failure.
